objective: Compare the nominal Size control semantics and spatial grain field response of Film Grunge grain and Add Noise monochrome mode near half-integer size boundaries, where the former rounds size to an integer block and the latter floors source coordinates divided by size.

effects: Film Grunge grain-only source equation, amount=.075, seed=1977, composition frame=0.
Add Noise CPU monochrome source equation, amount=.075, seed=1977.
scope.method: Offline Float32 source-equation models over a common 28x28 flat mid-gray opaque plate, with nominal size requests [1,1.49,1.5,1.51,2,2.49,2.5,2.51,3]. This size is bounded to avoid the known Film Grunge signed-coordinate multiplication overflow in its hash. Compare spatial field statistics and paired field differences; enlarge residual views only for inspection.
excluded: GPU/resident Add Noise and route parity
higher-resolution Film Grunge field due to signed overflow risk

comparison.baseline: Same .5-gray plate with each effect disabled; zero residual reference.
candidates: Film Grunge Grain Size and Add Noise Size at identical nominal values
same amount and seed label; algorithms retain their own source hash equations
comparison.ground_truth: None. These are deterministic source-equation fields, not film stock scans or compiled output.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive only. Verify source markers, zero-amount identity, alpha identity, finite residual, declared effective block size, and no out-of-domain Film Grunge coordinates. Do not declare equal size or amount visually equivalent.

materials.fixture: Synthetic 28x28 neutral gray .5 RGB, alpha=1. The plate isolates additive grain from image texture and keeps Film Grunge coordinate multiplications within signed int range.
materials.identity: Record plan/source/runner/fixture/output hashes; fixed seed/frame and all settings.

conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 RGB [0,1], source .5. Add Noise uses monochrome mode and bounded saturate; no clipping is expected at amount .075. Film Grunge retains channel multipliers .92/1/1.05. Alpha=1.
conditions.equation: Grunge block=max(1,round_half_away_from_zero(size)); grain scalar=((uint32_hash(seed/frame/xblock/yblock)&0xffff)/32767.5-1)*amount, with channel multipliers .92/1/1.05. Add Noise uses sample=floor(coord/size), channel salt 1 in mono mode, the CPU 32-bit hash low 24 bits mapped to [-1,1], then adds amount*noise to each RGB channel with clamp.
conditions.regions_and_rois: Whole 28x28 field; adjacent-pair correlation and horizontal/vertical run lengths are measured across the field.
metrics: unique residual values and field mean/stddev
RMSE and correlation between same-effect fields around size boundaries
conditions.display: Contact sheet shows four-times amplified deviation from .5 with common mapping; metrics use unamplified Float32 residuals.

effect_correctness.method: Verify equation markers, hash constants, seed/frame key, size mapping, zero amount, alpha and coordinate safety.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Pass model-invariant checks only; no runtime parity.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect enlarged 28x28 residual fields and report autocorrelation/run lengths.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic or film-realism judgment; tiny safe-domain crop is illustrative only.

color_and_alpha.method: Measure channel residuals, clipping and alpha identity on opaque mid-gray.
color_and_alpha.unverified: colored source, alpha edges, transfer function and non-gray tone response.

temporal_stability.reason: One seed/frame only; sequence and seek remain unmeasured.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: C++ output, high-resolution Film Grunge hash behavior and Add Noise GPU paths.

evaluation.decision: No effect selection, default change, or quality acceptance.

execution.backend: Python NumPy Float32 offline model; no UI/app/build/test.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed 28x28 fixture, seed/frame, size list, source and output hashes.
